en.name: Crawling Dragon (Rush Duel)
en.effect: This weakened dragon can no longer fly, but is still a deadly force to be reckoned with.

fr.name: Dragon Rampant
fr.effect: Ce dragon affaibli ne peut plus voler, mais il reste redoutable.

de.name: Kriechdrache

it.name: Drago Strisciante

es.name: Dragón Reptante

ko.name: 땅을 기는 드래곤
